scripts.minio:status: node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live',(r)=>{console.log('MinIO 状态:',r.statusCode===200?'运行中':'异常 ('+r.statusCode+')');process.exit(0)}).on('error',(e)=>{console.log('MinIO 状态: 未运行 ('+e.code+')');process.exit(1)})")
scripts.minio:reset: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path='./.minio-data';if(fs.existsSync(path)){fs.rmSync(path,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('已清理 '+path)}else{console.log(path+' 不存在，无需清理')}"
scripts.sync:docs: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=[['README.md','readme.md'],['CHANGELOG.md','changelog.md'],['CONTRIBUTING.md','contributing.md'],['docs/api.md','api.md'],['docs/architecture.md','architecture.md'],['docs/development.md','development.md'],['docs/testing.md','testing.md'],['docs/deployment.md','deployment.md']];m.forEach(([s,d])=>fs.copyFileSync(s,'frontend/src/docs/'+d));console.log('已同步 '+m.length+' 个文档文件')"
